page.layout: One printed page, title page, all centred. Top: title block in several lines and sizes. Middle: a woodcut vignette with the motto HONOS ALIT ARTES. Bottom: publisher and date lines. Show-through from the other side appears faintly and is left out. No running head, no page number printed.

main_text.l: Dicta Trajecti ad Rhenum, in acroaterio Theologico,
a. d. XVIII Novembr. CIↄ Iↄ C LXXIII.

page.notes: A manuscript numeral "3" at the upper right and a handwritten mark "W." beside the author's line near the top are not printed text and are left out. A small printed number at the top right corner edge is partly cut off and not legible. The woodcut shows a seated allegorical figure under a tree with banners reading "ULTRAJECTINA" (partly visible), "PATRIA" / "SEMPER" fragments, and the motto "HONOS ALIT ARTES" on a scroll below; the banner words are only partly readable and are not transcribed. Old-style numerals CIↄ Iↄ are rendered as MDCLXXIII in the printed sense but are copied as printed.
